title: NASA operator disconnects Gary during hack

tellings.quote: obviously when that guy right clicked the LAN icon and disconnected me, that was NAZA.

plain: While breaking into US government computers around 2001 and 2002, a British hacker named Gary McKinnon says someone on the other end caught him in the act. He recalls a person who "right clicked the LAN icon and disconnected me", meaning they cut his network connection by hand, and he is sure that was NASA, the US space agency. He tells it as his own experience, as proof that someone inside was watching what he was doing.
